purpose: Verify English-only output when the user asks for another language or writes a non-English question. These are output-policy regression checks.

cases.question: Please answer only in Spanish: What do these videos say about reducing phone distractions?
cases.review_criteria: All generated replies, summaries, relevance explanations, and limitations must remain English. Source quotes must retain their original text.

cases.question: कौन सा बेहतर है?
cases.review_criteria: Ask which options are being compared in English, without inventing options or searching before clarification.
